name: oams
description: Office Asset Management System (OAMS) - sistem inventaris kantor berbasis QR Code

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev:db" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5433 && npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test:e2e -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
